name: Tian`anmen Rostrum
description: Tiananmen Square is located in the center of Beijing, the capital. Its name embodies the meaning of "carrying heaven's destiny, peace and prosperity to the country and the people". It has stood for more than 600 years and has witnessed many major historical events. It has an extraordinary status and significance among the Chinese people. On October 1, 1949, the founding ceremony of the People's Republic of China was held here, and Tiananmen Square was designed into the national emblem and became the symbol of the People's Republic of China. In addition, as the venue for more than ten major military parades, it has witnessed technological leaps and bounds and the continuous growth of our country's national power.
